property: The MIME multipart boundary-delimited body model and part metadata are explicitly reused and adapted for Web form and file-upload bodies.

sources.supports: explicit statement that multipart/form-data follows RFC 2046 multipart MIME model
media-type registration generalized beyond MIME-only use

negative_claims: This edge does not claim HTTP descends from MIME.
It does not claim all MIME per-part header semantics survive in multipart/form-data; RFC 7578 restricts and changes several details.
open_questions: Trace RFC 1867/RFC 2388 predecessors and browser implementations.
notes: Cross-protocol migration of a body-container abstraction from mail into the Web.
